card.name: First word after a sentence break
card.fires_on: The first word right after a period or similar break that begins a new sentence or list item, often a small word like that, so, but, the or an. It also fires on a few mid-word pieces.

modes.label: Sentence-initial small word
modes.description: A short linking or article word starts the sentence right after a full stop.
modes.example: oh god yes.<< but>> they've only recently managed to get significantly

modes.label: Start of a new clause in drug text
modes.description: The first word after a period in label text, such as a patient group or conjunction.
modes.example: loss of therapeutic effect of simeprevir.<< so>>fosbuvir/velpatas

modes.label: Odd word pieces
modes.description: Partway through a URL or a split word.

card.plain: It lights up on the first word after a full stop, when a new sentence starts.
